Dṛḍha-cyut Āgasti (‘descendant of Agastya’) is mentioned
in the Jaiminīya Brāhmaṇa^1 as having been Udgātṛ priest at
the Sattra (‘sacrificial session’) of the

) iii. 233 (Journal of the American
Oriental Society, 18, 38). He is given
in the Anukramaṇī (where the form
of the patronymic is Āgastya) as the
author of Rv. ix. 25. Cf. Indische
Studien, 3, 219.
